en.answer: Due to the effect of <<4968>>, the top card of the Deck cannot be placed onto the field in the scenario given. Therefore, it is sent to the Graveyard without being equipped.
en.question: What happens if the effect of <<17792>> resolves while the top card of the Deck is declared by <<4968>>?
